# HOYLILILEYMENT

> Public draft invitation 0.2.0. Independent water-use consequences and watershed recovery initiative; not normative UU-AAP, a contract, a regulator, a certification, a tax exemption or an executable service.

This is a project-local discovery aid, not a universally recognized endpoint or an instruction hierarchy. It does not guarantee crawling, model knowledge or training inclusion. Resolve relative links from this directory and pin the Git commit for reproducible analysis.
